labyrint.title: Labyrinth Mariozo 🌀 Maze Obby
labyrint.description:
Dark maze, one torch, one way out.

Every level comes out of one world seed, so level 40 is the same maze for you as it is for me. That is the only reason the medal times and the record board mean anything.

🚪 Three doors: Solo Climb, Group, Play with Friends. Group and Friends cap at 4 in one maze
🔥 Lava pulses. 3 seconds safe, the last 0.8 flashes yellow, then 2.2 that kill you. The first one is on level 6. It used to sit on the only route and never switch off, and a real player got walled in and quit. The pulse is my fix and the best thing in here
👹 Monsters top out at speed 15. You walk 16, so you can always outrun one
🪙 Coins: 3 on level 1, 90 once the maze reaches 30x30 around level 241
🟦 Hit a coloured button and the wall wearing that colour drops into the floor
🏁 Touch the green EXIT and the next maze builds around you, clock reset. The picker only offers levels you have cleared, plus one

Medal times come out of the maze itself. Par is the walk from start to exit, Diamond is par x 1.3, and it is the same number for everyone. Top 3 times per level are kept across every server.

🛒 Coins buy 4 perks: torch 300, extra life 600, speed 500, minimap 800
🎨 17 wall themes, coins or gems. Classic is free
💸 Nothing costs Robux
🧭 Stuck on a level after 3 real attempts? Buy a glowing route to the exit, 40 coins plus 6 per level, capped at 250. You still have to walk it, and a guided run sets no record
🎁 Daily login pays 150 coins, 1050 on day 7
📱 Phone works. The side panels fold behind a button so they stay off your thumbstick

Built by an uncle and his nephew. No music yet.

🙏 Send a screenshot or a clip. If I use it, your name goes on the board in the lobby and the game pays you 25,000 coins and 2,500 gems the next time you join. I add people to that list by hand
👍 Like and favourite if you get past level 20

Can you clear level 50 without buying the route?

plus1.title: +1 Jump Every Step 🔼 Sky Temple Obby
plus1.description:
You start on a stone pad with a normal 7.2 stud jump. Every platform past the highest one you have already reached gives +1 Jump Power, and each point is +0.6 studs of height. Six platforms per tier.

One catch worth knowing before it annoys you: the +1 only fires on platforms past your highest. Skip one on the way up, come back for it later, and it pays nothing.

🏛️ Everyone in the server climbs the same tower, seed 20260905
⬇️ Fall and you get put back on the exact platform you last earned. No death, nothing lost
♻️ REBIRTH at tier 10, then 18, then 26. Multipliers 2x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, and they multiply jump HEIGHT only - you still earn +1 per platform
🏆 The top 10 board is your best tier ever, and it survives a rebirth
💾 Autosaves every 20 seconds

There are no kill bricks and no lava. You cannot die in this game at all. The red neon blocks from tier 5 up are decoration with collision off, so you pass straight through them.

Step height stops growing at tier 17 and jump height caps at 60 studs. Above that it is the same climb, forever, which is the point.

🎁 Codes: WELCOME, SKYHIGH, TEMPLE, LAUNCH. One use each. LAUNCH alone is +100 Jump Power, which parks you on the 60 stud ceiling straight off the pad
📱 Desktop, mobile and tablet. On a phone the two side panels fold behind a Menu button and a Top button along the top edge

Built solo, code only, no art.

Like it if you clear tier 20.

Is tier 10 too long a first climb before rebirth unlocks? That is the number I keep moving.

anomaly.title: Anomaly: Night Shift at the Observatory 🔭
anomaly.description:
Nothing chases you. The hall is torn down and rebuilt before every pass, and either it is clean or exactly one thing is wrong.

Walk the 80 studs and look at everything. Then:
E to ADVANCE if it looked clean.
Q to TURN BACK if you caught it.
Right call is Day +1. A wrong one puts you back on Day 1 no matter how deep you were.

H at the start pad spends a hint token, and all it tells you is clean or not clean, never which one. Phone and tablet get a tap button instead of the key.

Day 1 draws from the 8 obvious ones. A new type joins every 2 days and all 24 are in play from Day 33. The chance of an anomaly starts at 50% and stops climbing at 62% on Day 31. Miss one and the game names the thing you walked past, so you learn it for next time.

My two favourites: The Watcher stands at the far end facing you, and The Climber is upside down on the ceiling halfway along. Both have a red point light where the face should be.

⚠️ No sound at all yet. The wrong-call scare is a red flash and a camera shake, and that is the whole scare
🎁 Code WELCOME for 3 hint tokens
🔦 Turn the graphics up. The hall runs at ClockTime 0.2 and it is meant to be that dark

Catching one ticks a counter, 0/24. There is no book to open yet, just the number going up.

No gamepasses, no shop, no pets, no daily rewards. Built solo.

Is 50% on Day 1 too generous? That is the number I keep moving.

Tags: horror, spot the difference, anomaly, anomaly hunter, night shift, observatory, liminal, backrooms, single player, night shift horror
